title: feat(app-shell): the page designer's add-block picker offers the list view block
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb3jLLKvBmct3LQ4bsBRmBx5)_

Fixes #26794

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:页面设计器的「添加区块」选择器里新增「列表视图」(`list-view`),放在「数据」分类下,和表格、表单、指标、看板并列;中英文名称齐全。
- **为什么改**:上一张卡(PR #26793)给列表区块加了属性面板(对象、视图、条数上限),但选择器里没有这一项,设计器只能编辑页面里已有的列表区块,不能新加。
- **风险与回滚**:低。只加了选择器里的一行和两种语言的名称,删掉测试里为它留的豁免表;不新增元数据键,渲染端不动。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/block-types.ts` 新增的 `'list-view'` 一行;`previews/PageBlockCanvas.addListView-26794.test.tsx`;`previews/__tests__/block-config.test.ts` 删掉的 `PANEL_WITHOUT_PALETTE`。
- **两分钟验证**:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/PageBlockCanvas.addListView-26794.test.tsx`,预期 3 个用例全绿;或在 Studio 打开一个页面,点「添加区块」,在「数据」下选「列表视图」,右侧出现对象、视图、条数上限三个空框,画布上的列表提示先选对象。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The picker offers `list-view`.** `BLOCK_TYPE_META` gains a `list-view` row: category `data`, the `LayoutList` icon (the one its registration in plugin-list names), and the type label `engine.pageBlockCanvas.type.listView`, "List view" / "列表视图". `BlockTypeId` gains the id. `TYPES_BY_CATEGORY`, which the picker renders, is derived from that table, so nothing else changes in the picker.
- **The label lives in the `studio` namespace** of `@object-ui/i18n` (en + zh), beside the block's three inspector rows, as the claim's file surface names. Its sibling `engine.pageBlockCanvas.type.*` rows are still in app-shell's designer table (`views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`); the designer's `t()` asks that table first and the namespace second, so the picker reads either home the same way.
- **The exemption goes.** `previews/__tests__/block-config.test.ts` loses `PANEL_WITHOUT_PALETTE` and its self-deleting case; "a block with a config panel is a block the palette offers" now reads the palette with no exemption.
- **A fresh block carries no binding.** Measured on main: `addBlock` writes `{ type }` and selects it, and `ListViewBlock` with neither `data` nor `dataSource` draws its existing hint ("No object named: set data.object or dataSource.object.") rather than an empty list. So the chosen behaviour is "asks for its object": the block is written bare, and the panel's Object control writes `dataSource.object`. No canvas default was added.

## Tests

`previews/PageBlockCanvas.addListView-26794.test.tsx` drives the real picker in `PageBlockCanvas` and the real `PageBlockInspector`:

- the `list-view` row sits under the Data heading, named in en and zh (zh read from the catalogue and checked to differ from en);
- picking it writes `[{ type: 'list-view' }]` into the region, the draft passes `PageSchema.safeParse`, and the canvas selects `regions[0].components[0]`;
- that selection and draft, handed to the inspector, open Object, View and Row limit, all empty (Row limit hints 5), and typing an object writes `dataSource.object`.

## Acceptance notes

- The page-block type labels now live in two homes for one family (one row in the namespace, the rest in the designer table) until the #25922 slice that moves `engine.pageBlockCanvas.*` takes them; the open slice S4 (PR #26900) does not move that family.
